test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate homonyms from the given alternatives to fill in the blanks.

The rowing instructor commanded them to ________ in a ________.

A.row (verb)

B.roe

C.row (sequence)
solution:
The correct answer is '**A, C**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**row (verb)**" (A) means to propel a boat forward using oars. (पंक्तिबद्ध करना)
 
• The word "**row (sequence)**" (C) means a number of people or things in a more or less straight line. (श्रृंखला)
 
• In the sentence, "row" as a verb instructs them to row the boat, and "row" as a sequence indicates the formation they need to be in.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The rowing instructor commanded them to row__ in a __row__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Roe (मछलियों के अंडे)**: refers to the eggs of fish, not relevant to the context of rowing a boat.
